review_feedback: The goal is met and no critical defects were found in the submitted changes. The overwrite root cause was addressed by removing the automatic `onCharacterClick()` trigger in `AtchaSpeechCharacter` at composition start, which previously fired taxi-fare speech immediately on app launch. In `HomeViewModel`, initial speech is now explicitly set during init (including the no-alarm case via `home_bubble_map_text`), and taxi-fare speech is conditionally suppressed when an alarm is registered, preventing immediate replacement of intended startup messages. Build is successful, and I did not identify crash-risk, data-loss, or security/privacy regressions in this flow.
